name: Alpenhof
beschreibung: The Alpenhof is located in the municipality of **Tux** at an elevation of around 1,300 meters in the **Tuxertal** valley. The hotel serves as a starting point for summer and winter activities, including tours to the **ski and hiking areas** at the **Hintertuxer Gletscher**. Facilities include a restaurant offering regional cuisine, as well as a **wellness area** with a sauna and swimming pool. The rooms are furnished in alpine style and feature a balcony with views of the surrounding mountains. This is a family-run establishment, offering guests a peaceful stay away from through traffic.
